declared.title: How effective are acceptance strategies? A meta-analytic review of experimental results
declared.venue: Journal of Behavior Therapy and Experimental Psychiatry
declared.foundIn: docs/design/review-science.md (dossier du pilote, 2026-11-22) ; titre de mémoire de la session

population: 30 experimental studies comparing acceptance with other strategies

findings.text: In experiments, accepting does not reduce negative feelings more than other good strategies (reappraisal, distraction)

support.sentence: With respect to pain intensity and negative affect, meta-analysis did not show any significant differences between acceptance and other emotion regulation strategies.

findings.text: Accepting helps people tolerate pain longer than other strategies

support.sentence: Meta-analytic results replicate findings of primary studies for pain tolerance: A small to medium between-group ES was found favoring acceptance strategies (g = 0.43, p < 0.01, 95% CI[0.12, 0.73]).
